messages.content: An existing full-page DAO creation wizard needs a prefilled member-management step. Produce a compile-oriented implementation handoff, not a standalone prototype. Identify the supported design-system composition and exact contracts needed to: initialize existing member addresses, let users add/edit/remove rows, distinguish editable input from accepted/resolved addresses, report invalid and duplicate entries through the owning form, and preserve the wizard's existing form ownership and navigation. Include required provider assumptions, relevant address-resolution/checksum/network semantics, and revision-matched source or example references available in this project. Call out any tempting but incorrect nesting or state-ownership choices. Do not invent APIs; explicitly mark anything the supplied project cannot establish.

messages.content:
I can't fix these — both findings sit in the synced, read-only source (`_ds_bundle.css`, imported by `styles.css`), which is compiled Tailwind output from the repo. Editing it here would be overwritten on the next sync.

Also worth noting they're false positives rather than real token problems:

- The 32 "unregistered custom properties" are Tailwind's internal per-utility variables (`--tw-translate-x`, `.prose` typography vars, `space-y` reverse flags). They're implementation details of the emitted utilities, not theme tokens, and can't be hoisted to `:root` without breaking the utilities.
- The 15 unclassified tokens (`--ease-out`, `--animate-spin`, `--default-transition-duration`, etc.) are motion/animation tokens — a legitimate kind the classifier doesn't have. They'd want `/* @kind other */`, which has to be added in the repo's token source.

Both belong in the original code repo, then re-synced with `/design-sync` — mention them to that agent on the next run. Nothing in the project's own writable surface (`templates/`) is affected.
